dateStandard: Asia/Seoul calendar day when a state was usable in ordinary constructed matches, including normal generation; not announcement, archive commit, preload, or unrelated expansion/adventure/class unlock.

release.limits: Archive presence is combined with live parent availability and normal generation paths. No class or adventure unlock applies to these WoG parents.

negativeAndExclusionFindings.finding: Fiery Bat already has Beast race 20 and 1 mana 2/1 in 5.0. Race remains 20 across the 43 originally inspected sample builds through 37.0.2. No tribe or balance change is supported; formatting and quantity wording changes are separate.

negativeAndExclusionFindings: Classic balance adjustments accompanying the 2016 patches are outside this expansion.
Weapon durability moving between raw health/durability tags is a representation change, not an in-game durability nerf.
Neutral class 0 to 12 and token rarity cleanup are metadata unless tied to visible or gameplay changes.
CORE or COT copies alone never establish an original OG-ID delta.

launch_kr.evidence: Contemporary Korean report timestamped 2016-04-27 10:01 says the expansion released and its 134 collectible cards are available.

5.2.evidence: Korean title July 13, 2016; explicitly says Silithid Swarmer becomes a Beast. Displayed publication metadata is July 12.

6.0.evidence: Korean title August 10, 2016; some noncollectible summoned minion costs increased. Karazhan itself opens August 12.

6.1.3.evidence: Korean title October 4, 2016; Call of the Wild costs 9 and Yogg stops when killed or silenced. Publication metadata October 3 is not the Korean effective date.

6.1.3_announcement.evidence: Announcement additionally describes Yogg stopping after transformation or return to hand; its Overload bug will be corrected in a future patch, not this update.

6.2.evidence: Korean title October 21, 2016; explicitly fixes Yogg applying Overload. Classic Murloc adjustments in the same notes are outside this repository.

7.0.evidence: Korean title November 30, 2016. Gadgetzan unlock is separately December 2.

8.0.evidence: Korean update title April 5, 2017. This is the client patch, not the UnGoro expansion unlock on April 7.

8.0_contemporary.evidence: Contemporary Korean article says the patch applied April 5, before UnGoro releases April 7.

8.4.evidence: Korean title July 11, 2017; explicitly lists Hallazeal among five existing minions gaining Elemental. Displayed publication metadata is July 10.

9.0.evidence: Korean title August 9, 2017. Fandral text changes to apply to all Choose One abilities; Frozen Throne unlock is separately August 11.

10.0.evidence: Korean title December 7, 2017. Kobolds expansion opens December 8.

11.0.evidence: Korean title April 11, 2018; Witchwood unlock April 13. Old-card changes apply with the patch, not rotation.

12.2.evidence: Korean title October 3, 2018; patch deployment, not the later Halloween event.

12.2_contemporary.evidence: Contemporary Korean report explicitly says patch 12.2 applied October 3.

12.2_build.evidence: Commit message: Update to patch 12.2.0.26757. README version changes 12.0.0.25770 to 12.2.0.26757. Build 26757 is not an unexplained earlier patch.

12.2_jp.evidence: Contemporary Japanese title uses 12.2.0.26757 and says deployment early October 3 JST. Body mistakenly retains 12.0.0.25770; do not use that body version string as authoritative or JST alone as Korean evidence.

14.2.evidence: Korean title May 15, 2019; adventure opens May 17. Explicit Nat the Darkfisher probability fix. The six choice-option mana costs are not itemized in prose.

15.2.evidence: Korean title September 11, 2019; Tombs of Terror unlock September 18. Discover class weighting removed with the patch.

16.6.evidence: Korean title March 18, 2020; Call of the Wild 9 to 8 and Yogg continues casting after leaving the battlefield.

18.0.evidence: 18.0 applies today; Scholomance cards remain locked until August 7. Displayed metadata July 30 is not standalone Korean date proof.

18.0_kr.evidence: Contemporary Korean 18.0 notes posted 2020-07-31 02:02 and link official 23463127. Full page retrieval failed; images uninspected.

18.2.evidence: 18.2 patch features and Forbidden Library begin September 9; separate solo adventure September 16. Publication September 3 is an announcement date.

18.2_kr.evidence: Korean report posted September 15 explicitly says 18.2 applied September 9, 2020. Retrospective by six days, not same-day publication.

20.0.evidence: Explicitly says the March 26 patch adds schools to 545 previously released Standard and Wild spells. Core and expansion rotation March 31 is separate.

24.0.3.evidence: Stand Against Darkness mana 5 to 4 is explicitly itemized.

24.0.3_report.evidence: Report posted September 14 explicitly says the patch applied August 17. Later retrospective, not same-day; pictures uninspected.

25.0.evidence: Adds Undead and dual-type tags to previously released cards with 25.0. Text explicitly dates 25.0 to November 30; Lich King expansion and Death Knight unlock December 7 are separate.

25.0_kr.evidence: Korean post at 2022-11-29 03:01 says 25.0 applies tomorrow, supporting November 30.

26.0.evidence: Explicitly separates adjusted Core card changes April 5 from additions and removals April 12.

27.2.evidence: 27.2 begins August 23 KST and buffs existing Wild cards immediately; COT releases September 1. Named list gives 111 reprinted-card changes.

cot_originals.evidence: 113 reprints comprise 111 listed changes and two larger reworks shown as images. Original owned versions update at 27.2 and are immediately usable in Wild before COT release. Both rework images failed retrieval; visual contents were not verified.

chogall.evidence: 27.2 listing includes ChoGall reworked to 8 mana 8/8, returning discarded cards which cost Health. Original-ID archives supply the decisive identity and stat evidence.

27.4.2.evidence: Blade of CThun mana 6 to 7 explicitly itemized. Displayed September 28 is not the Korean effective date.

27.4.2_kr.evidence: Contemporary Korean post timestamped 2023-09-29 04:01 reproduces the today deployment statement.

29.0.evidence: Explicit today March 12, 2024 and schedule lists 29.0 patch and Core/non-Core balance changes March 12. Rotation March 20 is separate.

31.0.evidence: 31.0 patch explicitly October 30, 2024; The Great Dark Beyond unlock November 6 is separate. OG_221 Draenei attribution comes from original archive delta, not Core/reprint inference.

32.0.evidence: Card changes apply March 19, 2025; Core rotation March 26 is separate. Also explicitly introduces a 10-mana upper limit for evolve effects.

combined_druid.evidence: Exact original OG_044a / 38319: 20.0 attack 4 to 5 and Charge replaced by Rush; 26.0 mana 5 to 6, attack 5 to 7, health 6 to 9. Not a Core-only record.

37.0.evidence: Explicitly states 37.0 deploys October 14, 2026. Prerelease event paragraph gives 02:00 KST; October 21 expansion unlock is separate.

17.0.evidence: Korean title explicitly March 27, 2020 and introduction says patch 17.0 applies today. Demon Hunter prologue April 3 and expansion/class unlock April 8 are separate.

additionalFunctionalScopeNotes.change: Cards in this family can be generated, discovered or transformed into only when a related card was in the starting deck.
additionalFunctionalScopeNotes.limits: Official rule text inspected. Do not invent per-card printed-text changes; exact family membership requires separate card-tag evidence.

evidenceLimits: Comprehensive numeric and text migration is outside this independent date report.
The source registry distinguishes opened text from indexed excerpts. No uninspected image proves exact card stats.
The two COT rework images failed retrieval. ChoGall original archives plus textual secondary evidence support the rework; announcement prose establishes immediate original-card timing.
Foreign-calendar publication timestamps are not Korean deployment proof. Explicit Korean headings, deployment statements and contemporary Korean reports take precedence.

Archive derivatives were inspected with original XML sources retained; not every complete original XML was independently downloaded a second time. Build 26757 commit/README mapping was verified and corroborated by contemporary 12.2 reporting.
Choice-option mana cost changes are original archive attributes with a verified patch date; official prose does not list the six changes.
Late builder placeholders and localization markup changes do not justify invented gameplay events.
